name: Ruby Diamond of Eala
body:
Price 96,000 gp; Slot none; CL 10th; Weight 1 lb.; Aura moderate transmutation

DESCRIPTION

This fist-sized uncut gem looks like a human heart. One half is ruby-red with white flecks; the other is diamond-white with red flecks.

Five times per day when the gem is held in one hand, a spellcaster can use this item as an additional focus component when casting a spell that deals cold or fire damage, converting up to half the spell’s cold damage to fire damage or vice versa, as if using the Elemental Spell metamagic feat. Unlike the feat, this does not alter the casting time or spell level of the spell.

In addition, when held, the gem provides the bearer resistance 20 against cold and fire. At will as a free action, the bearer can command the ruby diamond of Eala to glow as brightly as a torch with either red or white flame, manipulate this light as if it were dancing lights, or snuff this light.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 48,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Elemental Spell; Spells resist energy
